details.query_text: MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object:Disease) WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' WITH subject, object, support, EXISTS { MATCH (subject)-[target:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION]->(object) WHERE target.predicate IN ['biolink:treats','biolink:ameliorates_condition','biolink:preventative_for_condition'] } AS visible RETURN count(*) AS source_ge2, sum(CASE WHEN support.source_count >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN support.source_count >= 3 AND visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_ge3_visible, sum(CASE WHEN support.source_count >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_ge4, sum(CASE WHEN support.source_count >= 4 AND visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_ge4_visible; MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[all_support:MINER_R0001_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object:Disease) WHERE all_support.artifact_id = 'r0001-treatment-source-support-v1' OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[non_target:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object) WHERE non_target.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' RETURN count(*) AS inclusive_ge2, sum(CASE WHEN non_target IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS also_non_target_ge2, sum(CASE WHEN all_support.source_count >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inclusive_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN all_support.source_count >= 3 AND coalesce(non_target.source_count,0) >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_target_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN all_support.source_count >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inclusive_ge4, sum(CASE WHEN all_support.source_count >= 4 AND coalesce(non_target.source_count,0) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_target_ge4; MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object:Disease) WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' AND support.source_count >= 3 MATCH (subject)-[semmed:TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object) WHERE semmed.predicate = 'biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat' AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(semmed.primary_knowledge_sources, []) UNWIND coalesce(semmed.publications, []) AS publication WITH subject, object, support, count(DISTINCT publication) AS publication_count WITH subject, object, support, publication_count, EXISTS { MATCH (subject)-[target:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION]->(object) WHERE target.predicate IN ['biolink:treats','biolink:ameliorates_condition','biolink:preventative_for_condition'] } AS visible RETURN count(*) AS source_ge3_and_semmed, sum(CASE WHEN publication_count >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publication_ge10, sum(CASE WHEN publication_count >= 10 AND visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publication_ge10_visible; MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[e:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object:Disease) WHERE e.predicate IN ['biolink:applied_to_treat','biolink:beneficial_in_models_for','biolink:in_clinical_trials_for','biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for','biolink:studied_to_treat','biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat'] UNWIND coalesce(e.primary_knowledge_sources, []) AS primary_source WITH subject, object, collect(DISTINCT primary_source) AS sources WHERE size(sources) >= 2 OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object) WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' RETURN count(*) AS raw_pairs, sum(CASE WHEN support IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS raw_without_materialized, sum(CASE WHEN support.source_count <> size(sources) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS source_count_mismatches, sum(CASE WHEN size(sources) >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS raw_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN size(sources) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS raw_ge4

details.query_text:
-- direct-affects-exact
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[e:AFFECTS]->(object:Disease) WHERE e.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, count(DISTINCT e) AS support_count, collect(DISTINCT e.edge_id) AS evidence_bindings

-- treatment-semmed-faers-convergence
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[s:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object:Disease) WHERE s.predicate IN ["biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:preventative_for_condition","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(s.primary_knowledge_sources, []) MATCH (subject)-[f:APPLIED_TO_TREAT]->(object) WHERE f.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat"] AND 'infores:faers' IN coalesce(f.primary_knowledge_sources, []) RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, count(DISTINCT s) + count(DISTINCT f) AS support_count, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(s.edge_id, '') + '|' + coalesce(f.edge_id, '')) AS evidence_bindings

-- treatment-semmed-faers-ctd-convergence
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[s:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object:Disease) WHERE s.predicate IN ["biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:preventative_for_condition","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(s.primary_knowledge_sources, []) MATCH (subject)-[f:APPLIED_TO_TREAT]->(object) WHERE f.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat"] AND 'infores:faers' IN coalesce(f.primary_knowledge_sources, []) MATCH (subject)-[c:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object) WHERE c.predicate IN ["biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:preventative_for_condition","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] AND 'infores:ctd' IN coalesce(c.primary_knowledge_sources, []) RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, count(DISTINCT s) + count(DISTINCT f) + count(DISTINCT c) AS support_count, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(s.edge_id, '') + '|' + coalesce(f.edge_id, '') + '|' + coalesce(c.edge_id, '')) AS evidence_bindings

-- direct-affects-physical-causal-convergence
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[a:AFFECTS]->(object:Disease) WHERE a.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] MATCH (subject)-[i:BINDS|DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[c:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(object) WHERE i.predicate IN ["biolink:binds","biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with"] AND c.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(a.edge_id, '') + '|' + coalesce(i.edge_id, '') + '|' + coalesce(c.edge_id, '')) AS evidence_bindings RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, support_count, evidence_bindings

-- direct-affects-chembl-physical-causal-convergence
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[a:AFFECTS]->(object:Disease) WHERE a.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] MATCH (subject)-[i:BINDS|DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[c:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(object) WHERE i.predicate IN ["biolink:binds","biolink:directly_physically_interacts_with"] AND 'infores:chembl' IN coalesce(i.primary_knowledge_sources, []) AND c.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(a.edge_id, '') + '|' + coalesce(i.edge_id, '') + '|' + coalesce(c.edge_id, '')) AS evidence_bindings RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, support_count, evidence_bindings

-- nontarget-treatment-two-sources
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object:Disease) WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' AND support.source_count >= 2 MATCH (subject)-[e:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object) WHERE e.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] WITH subject, object, support, collect(DISTINCT e.edge_id) AS evidence_bindings RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, support.source_count AS support_count, evidence_bindings

-- nontarget-treatment-three-sources
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object:Disease) WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' AND support.source_count >= 3 MATCH (subject)-[e:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object) WHERE e.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] WITH subject, object, support, collect(DISTINCT e.edge_id) AS evidence_bindings RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, support.source_count AS support_count, evidence_bindings

-- nontarget-treatment-four-sources
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(object:Disease) WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' AND support.source_count >= 4 MATCH (subject)-[e:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(object) WHERE e.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] WITH subject, object, support, collect(DISTINCT e.edge_id) AS evidence_bindings RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id, support.source_count AS support_count, evidence_bindings

Target-inclusive counterparts have identical eligible metrics, proving that direct visible target edges only add rows the scorer excludes and do not explain held-out performance.

details.query_text:
MATCH (d:Disease)-[h:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(p:PhenotypicFeature) WHERE h.predicate='biolink:has_phenotype' WITH p,count(DISTINCT d) AS disease_degree RETURN count(*) AS phenotypes,sum(disease_degree) AS disease_phenotype_pairs,min(disease_degree) AS minimum,max(disease_degree) AS maximum,avg(disease_degree) AS mean,percentileDisc(disease_degree,0.5) AS p50,percentileDisc(disease_degree,0.75) AS p75,percentileDisc(disease_degree,0.9) AS p90,percentileDisc(disease_degree,0.95) AS p95;
MATCH (annotated:Disease)-[h:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature) WHERE h.predicate='biolink:has_phenotype' WITH phenotype,count(DISTINCT annotated) AS disease_degree WHERE disease_degree<=10 MATCH (source:Disease)-[hs:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype)<-[ht:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(target:Disease) WHERE hs.predicate='biolink:has_phenotype' AND ht.predicate='biolink:has_phenotype' AND source<>target MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[t:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION]->(source) WHERE t.predicate IN ['biolink:treats','biolink:ameliorates_condition','biolink:preventative_for_condition'] WITH chemical,target,phenotype,disease_degree,count(DISTINCT source) AS treated_sources WITH chemical,target,count(DISTINCT phenotype) AS shared_rare_phenotypes,sum(1.0/log(1.0+disease_degree)) AS inverse_log_degree_score,EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[known:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION]->(target) WHERE known.predicate IN ['biolink:treats','biolink:ameliorates_condition','biolink:preventative_for_condition'] } AS visible WHERE shared_rare_phenotypes>=2 RETURN count(*) AS pairs,sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible,percentileDisc(inverse_log_degree_score,0.25) AS score_p25,percentileDisc(inverse_log_degree_score,0.5) AS score_p50,percentileDisc(inverse_log_degree_score,0.75) AS score_p75,percentileDisc(inverse_log_degree_score,0.9) AS score_p90,sum(CASE WHEN inverse_log_degree_score>=1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score_ge_1_5_pairs,sum(CASE WHEN inverse_log_degree_score>=1.5 AND visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score_ge_1_5_visible
details.result_summary: The graph has 9473 disease phenotype nodes and 161683 distinct disease-phenotype incidences; disease degree has median 3, p75 10, p90 34, and maximum 2237. Restricting to the observed p75 degree of 10 yielded 16572 transfer pairs/106 visible with one phenotype, 1293/39 with at least two, and 281/24 with at least three. Among the two-phenotype set, inverse-log-degree score had p25 0.969, median 1.072, p75 1.365, p90 1.770; the prespecified 1.5 score retained 248/23.

details.interpretation: The strong visible overlap at stricter phenotype support did not generalize. Disease phenotypic similarity alone is insufficient for treatment transfer in this graph.
details.method: Aggregate feedback scoring of the two-phenotype baseline, three-phenotype count variant, and inverse-log-degree weighted variant.
details.next_action: Stop phenotype threshold tuning and move to a different mechanistic family.

summary: Rare-phenotype disease similarity does not support reliable treatment transfer.

Retain the same degree-at-most-ten bound and at least two phenotype dimensions

details.rationale: Cross-resource treatment-oriented evidence measures indication support, while exact direct chemical-disease effects and signed causal-target paths supply distinct mechanistic evidence. Their intersection may improve precision without direct target-label reuse.

details.purpose: Determine whether explicit same-pair negative evidence can serve as a biologically defensible exclusion rather than a positive treatment signal.
details.query_text: MATCH (s:ChemicalEntity)-[r]->(d:Disease) WHERE any(x IN [adverse, side_effect, contraind, exacerbat, causes, predisposes, prevent] WHERE toLower(r.predicate) CONTAINS x) RETURN r.predicate, labels(s), count(*), count(DISTINCT s.id + | + d.id) ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 100; MATCH (s:Drug)-[a:AFFECTS]->(d:Disease) WHERE a.predicate = biolink:affects WITH DISTINCT s,d WITH s,d, EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[x:CONTRAINDICATED_IN]->(d) WHERE x.predicate = biolink:contraindicated_in } AS contraindicated, EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[x:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(d) WHERE x.predicate = biolink:has_side_effect } AS side_effect, EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[t:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(d) WHERE t.predicate IN [biolink:ameliorates_condition,biolink:preventative_for_condition,biolink:treats] } AS visible_treat RETURN contraindicated, side_effect, count(*), sum(CASE WHEN visible_treat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END); repeat the second query after requiring MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT.source_count >= 4.
details.result_summary: Drug-disease inventory found 55,116 side-effect edges and 16,129 contraindication edges for the principal Drug label signature. Among exact direct-affects Drug pairs: neither negative edge 4,550/356 visible, side effect only 342/80, contraindication only 77/11, both 87/10. Among four-source direct pairs: neither 415/201, side effect only 106/65, contraindication only 19/6, both 21/7.

details.proposed_test: Compare the four-source plus exact direct-affects rule with an otherwise identical rule that excludes any same-pair contraindicated-in edge under its full pinned descendant closure.
details.rationale: A candidate supported by provenance and direct affects is less credible when the same graph explicitly states that the drug is contraindicated in the disease. Exclusion is biologically interpretable and differs from requiring another positive arm.
details.success_criterion: Higher lower-bound precision without a disproportionate recall loss; side-effect evidence will not be used positively regardless of correlation.

summary: Explicit contraindication may remove mechanistically contradictory treatment candidates

details.proposed_test: Evaluate the standalone causal drug-target to gene-associated disease path, its intersection with exact direct drug-disease affects, a requirement for at least two distinct convergent genes, and a predeclared Jaccard target-overlap threshold of 0.05.
details.rationale: A direct drug-disease effect is more mechanistically credible when the drug causally affects one or more genes independently associated with the same disease. Normalizing shared targets can limit genetically broad diseases and promiscuous drugs.
details.success_criterion: The direct convergence improves precision over direct affects, and any count or normalized-overlap requirement improves precision for more than volume reduction alone.

details.purpose: Measure coverage and visible-label enrichment of causal drug-target paths through gene-associated-with-condition before constructing normalized grouping variants.
details.query_text: MATCH (g:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[x:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(d:Disease) WHERE x.predicate = biolink:gene_associated_with_condition RETURN count(*), count(DISTINCT g.id + | + d.id), count(DISTINCT g), count(DISTINCT d); MATCH (s:Drug)-[a:AFFECTS]->(g:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[x:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(d:Disease) WHERE a.predicate = biolink:affects AND x.predicate = biolink:gene_associated_with_condition WITH s,d,max(CASE WHEN a.qualified_predicate = biolink:causes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS causal_effect,count(DISTINCT g) AS genes WITH s,d,causal_effect,genes,EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[z:AFFECTS]->(d) WHERE z.predicate = biolink:affects } AS direct,EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[t:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(d) WHERE t.predicate IN [biolink:ameliorates_condition,biolink:preventative_for_condition,biolink:treats] } AS visible_treat RETURN direct,causal_effect = 1,count(*),sum(CASE WHEN visible_treat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),percentileCont(genes,0.5),percentileCont(genes,0.9).
details.result_summary: The genetic predicate has 36,577 unique gene-disease pairs, 12,970 genes, but only 79 diseases. Causal-effect paths without direct affects yielded 82,987 pairs and 1,064 visible hits. Requiring exact direct disease affects yielded 511 pairs and 153 visible hits; shared-gene count median 27 and p90 155. Noncausal exact affects paths added little.

summary: Profiled causal drug-target and genetic disease convergence

details.next_action: Record and evaluate both predeclared variants, then reject features that do not improve aggregate precision meaningfully.
details.purpose: Test predeclared grouping strategies for direct drug-disease affects plus causal drug-target genetic convergence without using feedback to choose thresholds.
details.query_text: MATCH (s:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(d:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate = biolink:affects MATCH (s)-[a:AFFECTS]->(g:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[x:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(d) WHERE a.predicate = biolink:affects AND a.qualified_predicate = biolink:causes AND x.predicate = biolink:gene_associated_with_condition WITH s,d,count(DISTINCT g) AS shared_genes CALL (s) { MATCH (s)-[at:AFFECTS]->(tg:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE at.predicate = biolink:affects AND at.qualified_predicate = biolink:causes RETURN count(DISTINCT tg) AS drug_targets } CALL (d) { MATCH (dg:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[ga:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(d) WHERE ga.predicate = biolink:gene_associated_with_condition RETURN count(DISTINCT dg) AS disease_genes } WITH s,d,shared_genes,drug_targets,disease_genes,toFloat(shared_genes)/(drug_targets+disease_genes-shared_genes) AS jaccard, EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[t:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(d) WHERE t.predicate IN [biolink:ameliorates_condition,biolink:preventative_for_condition,biolink:treats] } AS hit RETURN shared_genes >= 2,jaccard >= 0.05,count(*),sum(CASE WHEN hit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),percentileCont(shared_genes,0.5),percentileCont(jaccard,0.5),percentileCont(jaccard,0.9),min(drug_targets),max(drug_targets),min(disease_genes),max(disease_genes).
details.result_summary: Of 511 baseline pairs, 475 had at least two shared genes and 40 met Jaccard 0.05; all Jaccard-qualified pairs also had at least two genes. Baseline shared-gene median was 27. Non-Jaccard median score was about 0.0173 and p90 about 0.0344. Drug causal-target degrees ranged to 17,422 and disease genetic degrees to 2,386. The Jaccard subset had 4 visible hits among 40 pairs.

Gene-to-pathway has 26,478 involved-in and 5,328 acts-upstream-of-or-within edges. Pathway-disease evidence is limited to 9,045 generic genetic-association edges over 83 diseases. details.query_text: MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[tr:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(parent:Disease)<-[sc:SUBCLASS_OF]-(object:Disease) WHERE tr.predicate IN [biolink:ameliorates_condition,biolink:preventative_for_condition,biolink:treats] AND sc.predicate=biolink:subclass_of WITH subject,object,count(DISTINCT parent) AS parents RETURN parents>=2,count(*),visible target count; MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(parent:Disease)<-[sc:SUBCLASS_OF]-(object:Disease) WHERE support.artifact_id=r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1 AND support.source_count>=3 AND sc.predicate=biolink:subclass_of WITH subject,object,count(DISTINCT parent) AS parents, existence of exact direct affects and visible target RETURN direct,parents>=2,count(*),visible target count.
details.result_summary: Visible-target downward propagation produced 2,439,205 pairs with 4,115 visible labels and was too broad. Three-source non-target parent propagation without child direct affects produced 4,056,218 pairs with 3,697 visible labels. Requiring exact child affects reduced this to 765 pairs with 237 visible labels; 345 pairs with 134 visible labels had at least two supported parents. Direct subclass parents have median child degree 4, p90 46, and maximum 37,824.

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' AND support.source_count >= 3
MATCH (chemical)-[e:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(disease)
WHERE e.predicate IN $nontarget_predicates
UNWIND coalesce(e.primary_knowledge_sources, []) AS source
WITH DISTINCT chemical, disease, support.source_count AS source_count, source
WITH source, count(*) AS pairs_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN source_count >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pairs_ge4, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN source_count >= 4 AND EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_ge4
RETURN source, pairs_ge3, visible_ge3, toFloat(visible_ge3)/pairs_ge3 AS visible_ratio_ge3, pairs_ge4, visible_ge4, CASE WHEN pairs_ge4=0 THEN null ELSE toFloat(visible_ge4)/pairs_ge4 END AS visible_ratio_ge4 ORDER BY pairs_ge3 DESC;

MATCH (chemical:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' AND support.source_count >= 3
MATCH (chemical)-[e:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(disease)
WHERE e.predicate IN $nontarget_predicates
WITH DISTINCT chemical, disease, support.source_count AS source_count, e.predicate AS predicate
WITH predicate, count(*) AS pairs_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN source_count >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pairs_ge4, sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_ge3, sum(CASE WHEN source_count >= 4 AND EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_ge4
RETURN predicate, pairs_ge3, visible_ge3, toFloat(visible_ge3)/pairs_ge3 AS visible_ratio_ge3, pairs_ge4, visible_ge4, CASE WHEN pairs_ge4=0 THEN null ELSE toFloat(visible_ge4)/pairs_ge4 END AS visible_ratio_ge4 ORDER BY pairs_ge3 DESC;

MATCH (chemical:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' AND support.source_count >= 3
WITH chemical, disease, support.primary_sources AS primary_sources, support.source_count AS source_count, EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
WITH primary_sources, source_count, count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_pairs
RETURN primary_sources, source_count, pairs, visible_pairs, toFloat(visible_pairs)/pairs AS visible_ratio ORDER BY pairs DESC LIMIT 30;

MATCH (chemical:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1'
WITH chemical, disease, support.primary_sources AS sources, EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
UNWIND [{name:'faers_and_clinical', required:['infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}, {name:'semmed_and_faers', required:['infores:semmeddb','infores:faers']}, {name:'semmed_and_clinical', required:['infores:semmeddb','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}, {name:'semmed_faers_clinical', required:['infores:semmeddb','infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}, {name:'ctd_faers_clinical', required:['infores:ctd','infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}, {name:'ctd_semmed_faers', required:['infores:ctd','infores:semmeddb','infores:faers']}, {name:'ctd_semmed_clinical', required:['infores:ctd','infores:semmeddb','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}, {name:'ctd_semmed_faers_clinical', required:['infores:ctd','infores:semmeddb','infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}] AS definition
WITH definition, visible, all(source IN definition.required WHERE source IN sources) AS qualifies WHERE qualifies
RETURN definition.name AS evidence_roles, definition.required AS required_sources, count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_pairs, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))/count(*) AS visible_ratio ORDER BY size(definition.required), evidence_roles
details.result_summary: Among 16,905 pairs with at least three sources, source occurrences were targeted text mining 15,586, multiomics clinical trials 13,470, FAERS 11,197, SemMedDB 9,480, CTD 6,441, TTD 785, and Drug Repurposing Hub 55. The parent predicate occurred on 16,882 pairs, clinical-trial evidence on 13,532, applied-use evidence on 11,197, studied-to-treat on 61, and preclinical evidence on 6. Requiring SemMedDB, FAERS, and multiomics clinical-trial roles retained 3,431 pairs with 1,383 visible targets (40.31%); adding CTD retained 1,251 with 594 visible targets (47.48%). Pairwise component counts were FAERS plus clinical 12,331/2,894 visible, SemMedDB plus clinical 10,207/2,235, and SemMedDB plus FAERS 5,715/1,844. CTD plus FAERS plus clinical retained 2,145/913; CTD plus SemMedDB plus clinical retained 2,238/816; CTD plus SemMedDB plus FAERS retained 1,966/797.

details.query_text:
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate = 'biolink:affects'
MATCH (drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[association:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(disease)
WHERE effect.predicate = 'biolink:affects' AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes' AND association.predicate = 'biolink:gene_associated_with_condition'
WITH drug, disease, collect(DISTINCT direct) AS direct_edges, collect(DISTINCT effect) AS effect_edges, collect(DISTINCT association) AS association_edges, count(DISTINCT gene) AS genes, EXISTS { MATCH (drug)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
RETURN drug.id AS subject_id, disease.id AS object_id, genes, visible, reduce(all_sources = [], edge IN direct_edges | all_sources + coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AS direct_sources, reduce(all_sources = [], edge IN effect_edges | all_sources + coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AS effect_sources, reduce(all_sources = [], edge IN association_edges | all_sources + coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AS association_sources;

MATCH (drug:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate = 'biolink:affects'
MATCH (drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[association:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(disease)
WHERE effect.predicate = 'biolink:affects' AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes' AND association.predicate = 'biolink:gene_associated_with_condition'
WITH drug, disease, collect(DISTINCT effect) AS effects, EXISTS { MATCH (drug)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
UNWIND [{name:'chembl', sources:['infores:chembl']}, {name:'curated_pharmacology', sources:['infores:chembl','infores:gtopdb','infores:drugcentral']}, {name:'curated_target_resources', sources:['infores:chembl','infores:gtopdb','infores:drugcentral','infores:dgidb']}, {name:'curated_pharmacology_decreased', sources:['infores:chembl','infores:gtopdb','infores:drugcentral']}, {name:'curated_pharmacology_increased', sources:['infores:chembl','infores:gtopdb','infores:drugcentral']}] AS definition
WITH definition, effects, visible, CASE definition.name WHEN 'curated_pharmacology_decreased' THEN any(edge IN effects WHERE any(source IN definition.sources WHERE source IN coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AND edge.object_direction_qualifier='decreased' AND edge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']) WHEN 'curated_pharmacology_increased' THEN any(edge IN effects WHERE any(source IN definition.sources WHERE source IN coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AND edge.object_direction_qualifier='increased' AND edge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']) ELSE any(edge IN effects WHERE any(source IN definition.sources WHERE source IN coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, []))) END AS qualifies
WHERE qualifies
RETURN definition.name AS variant, definition.sources AS sources, count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_pairs, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))/count(*) AS visible_ratio ORDER BY pairs DESC
details.result_summary: The bounded baseline reproduced 511 pairs and 153 visible targets. Every direct drug-disease edge was sourced by SemMedDB, and every genetic association was sourced by GeneticsKP. Requiring target-effect sources disjoint from the direct SemMedDB arm retained 304 pairs with 97 visible targets, only a small enrichment. A ChEMBL target effect retained 107/41. A prespecified curated pharmacology source set of ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral retained 127/49; requiring decreased activity or activity-or-abundance retained 104/42, while the opposite-sign increased control retained 35/12. Adding DGIdb increased volume to 160/54 but diluted visible enrichment.

details.query_text:
MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[edge]->(disease:Disease) RETURN edge.predicate AS predicate, type(edge) AS relationship_type, count(*) AS edges, count(DISTINCT gene) AS genes, count(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases ORDER BY edges DESC;
MATCH (disease:Disease)-[edge]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) RETURN edge.predicate AS predicate, type(edge) AS relationship_type, count(*) AS edges, count(DISTINCT gene) AS genes, count(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases ORDER BY edges DESC;

MATCH (drug:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate = 'biolink:affects'
MATCH (drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[disease_edge]->(disease)
WHERE effect.predicate = 'biolink:affects' AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes' AND any(source IN $curated_sources WHERE source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AND disease_edge.predicate IN $disease_predicates
WITH disease_edge.predicate AS predicate, drug, disease, count(DISTINCT gene) AS genes, EXISTS { MATCH (drug)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
RETURN predicate, count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_pairs, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))/count(*) AS visible_ratio, percentileCont(genes,0.5) AS median_genes, percentileCont(genes,0.9) AS p90_genes ORDER BY pairs DESC;

MATCH (drug:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate = 'biolink:affects'
MATCH (drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(disease)
WHERE effect.predicate = 'biolink:affects' AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes' AND any(source IN $curated_sources WHERE source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AND association.predicate = 'biolink:associated_with'
WITH drug, disease, collect(DISTINCT effect) AS effects, collect(DISTINCT association) AS associations, count(DISTINCT gene) AS genes, EXISTS { MATCH (drug)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
RETURN drug.id AS subject_id, disease.id AS object_id, genes, visible, reduce(all_sources = [], edge IN associations | all_sources + coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AS association_sources, any(edge IN effects WHERE edge.object_direction_qualifier='decreased' AND edge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']) AS has_decreased, any(edge IN effects WHERE edge.object_direction_qualifier='increased' AND edge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']) AS has_increased
details.result_summary: Gene-to-disease inventory found no exact biomarker_for edges. In the direct-effect plus broad curated-target pattern, exact associated_with produced 187 pairs with 69 visible targets, versus genetic association 160/54, gene causes 167/28, predisposes 165/29, exact affects 256/39, and disrupts 50/12. Of the 187 associated-with pairs, 176 use HPO annotations. Requiring decreased target activity retained 136/54 visible; the increased-direction control retained 74/19.

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1'
MATCH (chemical)-[literature:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(disease)
WHERE literature.predicate IN $nontarget_predicates AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(literature.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
UNWIND coalesce(literature.publications, []) AS publication
WITH chemical, disease, support.primary_sources AS sources, count(DISTINCT publication) AS publication_count, EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
UNWIND [{name:'semmed_faers_clinical_ten_publications', required:['infores:semmeddb','infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}, {name:'ctd_semmed_faers_clinical_ten_publications', required:['infores:ctd','infores:semmeddb','infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials']}] AS definition
WITH definition, publication_count, visible, all(source IN definition.required WHERE source IN sources) AS role_match
WHERE role_match AND publication_count >= 10
RETURN definition.name AS variant, count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_pairs, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))/count(*) AS visible_ratio, percentileCont(publication_count,0.5) AS median_publications, percentileCont(publication_count,0.9) AS p90_publications, max(publication_count) AS maximum_publications ORDER BY pairs DESC

details.query_text:
MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[risk:PREDISPOSES_TO_CONDITION]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE risk.predicate = 'biolink:predisposes_to_condition'
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
WHERE effect.predicate = 'biolink:affects' AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
WITH drug, disease, collect(DISTINCT effect) AS effects, count(DISTINCT gene) AS genes, EXISTS { MATCH (drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease) WHERE direct.predicate='biolink:affects' } AS has_direct, EXISTS { MATCH (drug)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
UNWIND [{name:'all_source', direct:false, curated:false, direction:'any'}, {name:'direct_all_source', direct:true, curated:false, direction:'any'}, {name:'direct_curated', direct:true, curated:true, direction:'any'}, {name:'direct_curated_decreased', direct:true, curated:true, direction:'decreased'}, {name:'direct_curated_increased', direct:true, curated:true, direction:'increased'}] AS definition
WITH definition, visible, has_direct, effects, any(edge IN effects WHERE any(source IN $curated_sources WHERE source IN coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AND (definition.direction='any' OR (edge.object_direction_qualifier=definition.direction AND edge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']))) AS has_curated_direction, any(edge IN effects WHERE definition.direction='any' OR (edge.object_direction_qualifier=definition.direction AND edge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance'])) AS has_direction
WHERE (NOT definition.direct OR has_direct) AND (CASE WHEN definition.curated THEN has_curated_direction ELSE has_direction END)
RETURN definition.name AS variant, count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_pairs, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))/count(*) AS visible_ratio ORDER BY pairs DESC

details.purpose: Test whether source independence and curated target provenance improve direct drug-disease effects connected through genes that cause or contribute to disease.
details.query_text:
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate = 'biolink:affects'
MATCH (drug)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
WHERE effect.predicate = 'biolink:affects' AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes' AND causal.predicate IN ['biolink:causes','biolink:contributes_to']
WITH drug, disease, collect(DISTINCT effect) AS effects, EXISTS { MATCH (drug)-[target:AMELIORATES_CONDITION|PREVENTATIVE_FOR_CONDITION|TREATS]->(disease) WHERE target.predicate IN $target_predicates } AS visible
UNWIND [{name:'curated_any_direction', direction:'any'}, {name:'curated_decreased', direction:'decreased'}, {name:'curated_increased', direction:'increased'}, {name:'source_disjoint_any_direction', direction:'disjoint'}] AS definition
WITH definition, visible, effects, CASE definition.direction WHEN 'disjoint' THEN none(edge IN effects WHERE 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) WHEN 'any' THEN any(edge IN effects WHERE any(source IN $curated_sources WHERE source IN coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, []))) ELSE any(edge IN effects WHERE any(source IN $curated_sources WHERE source IN coalesce(edge.primary_knowledge_sources, [])) AND edge.object_direction_qualifier=definition.direction AND edge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']) END AS qualifies
WHERE qualifies
RETURN definition.name AS variant, count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_pairs, toFloat(sum(CASE WHEN visible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))/count(*) AS visible_ratio ORDER BY pairs DESC

Curated provenance improved visible enrichment over the inherited all-source decreased rule, but decreased direction did not improve over unrestricted curated target action.

details.query_text: MATCH (s:ChemicalEntity)-[support:MINER_R0001_NONTARGET_TREATMENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT]->(o:Disease) WHERE support.artifact_id = 'r0001-nontarget-treatment-source-support-v1' WITH s,o,support, all(x IN ['infores:semmeddb','infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials'] WHERE x IN support.primary_sources) AS role3, all(x IN ['infores:ctd','infores:semmeddb','infores:faers','infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials'] WHERE x IN support.primary_sources) AS role4 OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[a:AFFECTS]->(o) WHERE a.predicate='biolink:affects' WITH s,o,role3,role4,count(a)>0 AS direct OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[lit]->(o) WHERE lit.predicate IN ['biolink:applied_to_treat','biolink:beneficial_in_models_for','biolink:in_clinical_trials_for','biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for','biolink:studied_to_treat','biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat'] AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN coalesce(lit.primary_knowledge_sources,[]) WITH s,o,role3,role4,direct,reduce(pubs=[], e IN collect(DISTINCT lit) | pubs + coalesce(e.publications,[])) AS pubs WITH s,o,role3,role4,direct,size(reduce(acc=[], p IN pubs | CASE WHEN p IN acc THEN acc ELSE acc+p END)) >= 10 AS pub10, EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[t]->(o) WHERE t.predicate IN ['biolink:treats','biolink:ameliorates_condition','biolink:preventative_for_condition'] } AS train UNWIND [['role3',role3],['role3-direct',role3 AND direct],['role3-pub10',role3 AND pub10],['role3-direct-pub10',role3 AND direct AND pub10],['role4',role4],['role4-direct',role4 AND direct],['role4-pub10',role4 AND pub10],['role4-direct-pub10',role4 AND direct AND pub10]] AS x WITH x[0] AS cohort,x[1] AS keep,train WHERE keep RETURN cohort,count(*) AS pairs,sum(CASE WHEN train THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visible_hits,round(1000.0*sum(CASE WHEN train THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*))/10.0 AS visible_pct ORDER BY cohort

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  WITH DISTINCT gene,diseases
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] AND disease IN diseases
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND EXISTS {   MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] } 
RETURN DISTINCT disease.id AS disease_id ORDER BY disease_id LIMIT 10

details.purpose: Constrain direct disease neighborhoods, deduplicate causal genes and regulator-sign pairs, then join incoming signed drug targets.
details.query_text:
EXPLAIN MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH disease,collect(DISTINCT chemical) AS chemicals
CALL (disease,chemicals) {
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  WITH DISTINCT gene,chemicals
  MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  WITH DISTINCT gene,regulator,bridge.object_direction_qualifier AS regulatory_direction,chemicals
  MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier<>regulatory_direction
    AND chemical IN chemicals
  RETURN chemical,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.purpose: Constrain direct disease neighborhoods, deduplicate causal genes and regulator-sign pairs, then join incoming signed drug targets.
details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND disease.id IN $diseases
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  WITH DISTINCT gene,diseases
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] AND disease IN diseases
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"] AND EXISTS {   MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] } 
RETURN DISTINCT disease.id AS disease_id ORDER BY disease_id LIMIT 10

details.query_text:
EXPLAIN MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
WITH disease,collect(DISTINCT chemical) AS chemicals
CALL (disease,chemicals) {
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  WITH DISTINCT gene,chemicals
  MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  WITH DISTINCT gene,regulator,bridge.object_direction_qualifier AS regulatory_direction,chemicals
  MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(regulator)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier<>regulatory_direction
    AND chemical IN chemicals
  RETURN chemical,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.prior_cypher_template:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}}
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}}
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:{{relationship_types:bridge}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN {{predicates:bridge}}
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  WITH DISTINCT gene,diseases
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} AND disease IN diseases
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count
details.replacement_cypher_template:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}}
WITH DISTINCT chemical,disease
CALL (chemical,disease) {
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}}
  WITH DISTINCT chemical,gene
  MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:{{relationship_types:bridge}}]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN {{predicates:bridge}}
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']

MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"] AND disease.id IN $diseases
WITH DISTINCT chemical,disease
CALL (chemical,disease) {
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  WITH DISTINCT chemical,gene
  MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  WITH DISTINCT chemical,regulator,gene,bridge.object_direction_qualifier AS regulatory_direction
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(regulator)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'

EXPLAIN MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,drug_direction,
    CASE WHEN drug_direction='increased' THEN context.decreased_gene_element_ids
         ELSE context.increased_gene_element_ids END AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND disease.id IN $diseases
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,drug_direction,
    CASE WHEN drug_direction='increased' THEN context.decreased_gene_element_ids
         ELSE context.increased_gene_element_ids END AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"] AND disease.id IN $diseases
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,drug_direction,
    CASE WHEN drug_direction='increased' THEN context.decreased_gene_element_ids
         ELSE context.increased_gene_element_ids END AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects","biolink:affects_response_to","biolink:ameliorates_condition","biolink:decreases_response_to","biolink:disrupts","biolink:exacerbates_condition","biolink:has_adverse_event","biolink:has_side_effect","biolink:increases_response_to","biolink:regulates"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

CALL () { MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes", "biolink:contributes_to"] WITH gene,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects", "biolink:affects_response_to", "biolink:ameliorates_condition", "biolink:decreases_response_to", "biolink:disrupts", "biolink:exacerbates_condition", "biolink:has_adverse_event", "biolink:has_side_effect", "biolink:increases_response_to", "biolink:regulates"] AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes' AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased'] AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance'] AND regulator<>gene WITH DISTINCT regulator,gene,diseases,bridge.object_direction_qualifier AS direction UNWIND diseases AS disease WITH regulator,disease,collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN direction='increased' THEN elementId(gene) END) AS increased_gene_element_ids,collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN direction='decreased' THEN elementId(gene) END) AS decreased_gene_element_ids RETURN regulator,disease,increased_gene_element_ids,decreased_gene_element_ids }
MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH chemical,regulator,disease,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction, CASE WHEN target.object_direction_qualifier='increased' THEN decreased_gene_element_ids ELSE increased_gene_element_ids END AS downstream_gene_ids
UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

details.purpose: Compute the original raw biological rule without stored context access.
details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND disease.id IN $diseases
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  WITH DISTINCT gene,diseases
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] AND disease IN diseases
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND elementId(chemical) IN $chemical_nodes
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  WITH DISTINCT gene,diseases
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] AND disease IN diseases
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.query_text: MATCH (chemical:Drug) WHERE elementId(chemical) IN $chemical_nodes WITH chemical MATCH (parent:Drug)-[indication:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(disease:Disease) WHERE indication.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] MATCH (parent:Drug)-[parent_target:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE parent_target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND parent_target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(parent_target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[candidate_target:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE candidate_target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND candidate_target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(candidate_target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND (chemical<>parent) WITH DISTINCT chemical,parent,gene,disease CALL { WITH parent,disease MATCH (parent)-[role_edge:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(disease) WHERE role_edge.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] UNWIND coalesce(role_edge.primary_knowledge_sources,[]) AS source RETURN collect(DISTINCT source) AS raw_sources } WITH chemical,parent,gene,disease WHERE all(source IN ["infores:semmeddb", "infores:faers", "infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials"] WHERE source IN raw_sources) WITH chemical,disease,collect(DISTINCT gene.id) AS shared_genes WHERE size(shared_genes)>=1 RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,size(shared_genes) AS support_count

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND EXISTS { MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance'] } RETURN DISTINCT elementId(chemical) AS chemical_node ORDER BY chemical_node

details.purpose: Compute the original raw biological rule without stored context access.
details.query_text:
EXPLAIN MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND elementId(chemical) IN $chemical_nodes
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  WITH DISTINCT gene,diseases
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] AND disease IN diseases
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND elementId(chemical) IN $chemical_nodes

    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
  WITH DISTINCT gene,diseases
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"] AND disease IN diseases
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

details.query_text: MATCH (chemical:Drug) WHERE elementId(chemical) IN $chemical_nodes WITH chemical MATCH (parent:Drug)-[indication:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(disease:Disease) WHERE indication.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] MATCH (parent:Drug)-[parent_target:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE parent_target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND parent_target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND parent_target.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND parent_target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(parent_target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[candidate_target:AFFECTS]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE candidate_target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND candidate_target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND candidate_target.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND candidate_target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(candidate_target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"] AND (chemical<>parent) AND (candidate_target.object_direction_qualifier=parent_target.object_direction_qualifier) WITH DISTINCT chemical,parent,gene,disease CALL { WITH parent,disease MATCH (parent)-[role_edge:APPLIED_TO_TREAT|BENEFICIAL_IN_MODELS_FOR|IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|IN_PRECLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR|STUDIED_TO_TREAT|TREATS_OR_APPLIED_OR_STUDIED_TO_TREAT]->(disease) WHERE role_edge.predicate IN ["biolink:applied_to_treat","biolink:beneficial_in_models_for","biolink:in_clinical_trials_for","biolink:in_preclinical_trials_for","biolink:studied_to_treat","biolink:treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat"] UNWIND coalesce(role_edge.primary_knowledge_sources,[]) AS source RETURN collect(DISTINCT source) AS raw_sources } WITH chemical,parent,gene,disease WHERE all(source IN ["infores:semmeddb", "infores:faers", "infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials"] WHERE source IN raw_sources) WITH chemical,disease,collect(DISTINCT gene.id) AS shared_genes WHERE size(shared_genes)>=1 RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,size(shared_genes) AS support_count

MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,drug_direction,
    CASE WHEN drug_direction='increased' THEN context.increased_gene_element_ids
         ELSE context.decreased_gene_element_ids END AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction=bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

details.query_text:
MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:AFFECTS]->(disease:Disease)
WHERE direct.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
WITH chemical,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases
CALL (chemical,diseases) {
  MATCH (chemical)-[target:AFFECTS]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE target.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND target.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
  WITH DISTINCT regulator,target.object_direction_qualifier AS drug_direction,diseases
  MATCH (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease)
  WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1'
    AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915'
    AND disease IN diseases
  WITH regulator,disease,drug_direction,
    CASE WHEN drug_direction='increased' THEN context.decreased_gene_element_ids
         ELSE context.increased_gene_element_ids END AS downstream_gene_ids
  UNWIND downstream_gene_ids AS downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)
  WHERE elementId(gene)=downstream_gene_id
  MATCH (regulator)-[bridge:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects"]
    AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes'
    AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased']
    AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance']
    AND regulator<>gene
    AND drug_direction<>bridge.object_direction_qualifier
  MATCH (gene)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease)
  WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes","biolink:contributes_to"]
  RETURN disease,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count
}
RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,support_count

Signed qualified affects chains expand earlier unsigned regulation, and active-metabolite targeting extends earlier chemical transfer.
Process and family rules test exact-target genetic side arms, while transfer rules repair the previously ambiguous pooled-versus-same-parent grouping and retain matched controls.

This invocation added the taxonomic molecular-intervention family and its complete thirteen-rule recorded set, including opposite direction, direct evidence, same-organism two-target, production, full-closure, and zero-edge controls.

Two compact documented graph caches were added this round: curated causal target access and signed regulator-to-causal-disease context. Their role is computational access, not a fitted biological prediction score.
