The fixed small-protein-family constraint improved a sparse training point but yielded only one feedback hit among fifteen eligible predictions; it is not a supported general specificity improvement.
Two-arm process perturbation did not improve reliable prediction. Gene-style aspect qualifiers returned zero process matches; direction-only variants were executable but weak.
Active-metabolite targeting returned no feedback hits in the two recorded baseline sets of eighty-seven and eighty eligible predictions.

Disease-production genetic corroboration, expression-opposition diagnostics, explicit protein-gene identity, and explicit taxonomic-edge diagnostics produced zero outputs under their documented evidence requirements.

Requiring two inhibited molecular targets in the same organism reduced taxonomic feedback precision and recall. Requiring explicit organism production alongside matching molecular taxonomy eliminated all outputs.
Pathogen-product and molecular-activity mechanisms yielded low precision or very small direct-corroboration subsets; no therapeutic mechanism was validated by those associations.

details.family_count_interpretation: The 15 schema family IDs represented this round include controls, diagnostics, and extensions of earlier mechanisms. They are not 15 wholly new biological mechanisms, and parameter variants are not counted as independent mechanisms.

graph_gaps: Gene-to-disease causation, contribution, and genetic association do not supply the risk direction of ordinary gene activity. Composed molecular signs alone cannot establish therapeutic correction.
The process-genetic and gene-genetic corroboration arms use the same Genetics Knowledge Portal MAGMA source; they are structurally distinct arms, not independent provenance.

Only twenty of 526 inspected organism-to-molecular-product pairs had molecular taxonomy annotations, and all twenty disagreed with the producing organism. Visible human-annotated STX2 and VIM2P examples indicate identity or host-context ambiguity, not a proven error in every production edge.

The graph has no explicit in_taxon edges. Taxonomic intervention instead uses exact matching of existing taxon or in_taxon node properties against organism identifiers and equivalent identifiers, without external mappings or taxonomic ancestry. Annotation-level provenance was not available in the inspected properties.

The inspected disease-to-gene affects edges lack usable sign and aspect qualifiers; explicit protein-gene product identity predicates were absent. Zero-result diagnostics therefore reflect evidence availability, not treatment refutation.
Gandalf metadata returns JSON null, but bounded query requests work. The taxonomic property join is partial TRAPI and requires the documented external property filter.

Three complete joint raw-feature-removal transfer checks remain unfinished after bounded partition attempts. Partial coverage was not accepted as exact reproduction, although individual component removals completed.

One supplementary final full-closure all-source net-decrease control rerun timed out at its 120-second client limit. This is a final recorded-query execution gap, separate from earlier completed exhaustive raw equivalence checks and from the successfully rerun frontier rules.

119 schema-valid, completely profiled active candidates remain unrecorded. The required official recorder revalidates the entire cumulative two-million-row ledger per candidate; publication throughput, serialized graph execution, and the deadline prevented completing that backlog. No prediction or feedback records were invented.

Resolve the three remaining joint raw transfer verification gaps with bounded, tractable formulations rather than interpreting timeouts as biological failures. Revisit the optional full-closure control rerun under an appropriate explicit resource budget.

Seek graph-supported disease-context and target-essentiality evidence for the largely distinct protein-family and taxonomic candidate volumes; do not assume molecular inhibition, shared family membership, or organism identity establishes treatment.
Seek genuinely independent provenance and usable causal risk direction before strengthening mechanistic language for genetic and regulatory corroboration.
Preserve both treatment-evidence surfaces independently, retain failed and zero-result controls, and avoid feedback-driven threshold sweeps.

Keep the overall run open. Any later portfolio feedback must use the remaining shared budget and complete deduplicated prediction sets; do not infer hidden hits within novel subsets or request final scoring.

novel_prediction_volume.interpretation: Novel endpoint coverage only. The two complete rules received aggregate feedback, but neither novel subset nor their union was scored as a portfolio. Their precision and hidden hit counts cannot be inferred from the full-rule feedback.

details.pareto_summary: Four precision-recall surfaces were computed independently with exact rational comparisons in event 1840. Feedback: treats included has 17 members and treats excluded has 17. Training: treats included has 6 and treats excluded has 15. Treats included admits all eligible rules, including treatment-free rules; treats excluded admits only rules whose effective expanded body predicates contain no treatment-oriented evidence. The union contains 39 rule IDs; four previously documented semantic or source-mismatch formulations remain ineligible. Relative to the prior rounds, the feedback treats-included frontier is unchanged. The treatment-free frontier grows from 12 to 17 members, with 10 round-four additions replacing 5 prior members. The highest treatment-free feedback precision lower bound is 4/11 for process plus exact-target genetic corroboration, with very low recall and no novel pairs versus all prior rules. The strongest treatment-free feedback F0.5 point is the all-source net-increase control, approximately 0.032192, not the corrective net-decrease hypothesis. All precision values are lower bounds; unlabeled predictions are not known negatives. Frontier membership denotes predictive nondominance, not a validated treatment mechanism. Final labels remain unavailable.
